evaluation: FORWARD ONLY. Eligible listings: Binance USD-M USDT perpetuals with onboardDate >= 2026-11-02 00:00 UTC. No historical backtest of this rule is used as evidence (the guard was motivated by S115 results).
motivation: S115: new listings drift down (median short +4-7%, BTC-hedged positive) but squeeze tails paid through deeply negative funding destroyed the mean (e.g. FUNUSDT -36.7% funding in 5 days).

rules.universe: new USDT perpetuals excluding BTC/ETH, stablecoin/commodity bases and index symbols
rules.entry: paper short at the open of the 2nd daily bar after listing (first bar may be partial), $25 notional
rules.entry_guard: skip the listing if the sum of funding settled during the first daily bar is < -0.10% (shorts already crowded)
rules.stop: +35% above entry, checked on daily highs; fill at max(stop, bar open)
rules.funding_exit: exit at the daily close on the first day cumulative funding since entry is <= -3.0%
rules.time_exit: close of the 14th daily bar after entry
rules.concurrency: at most 5 open paper positions; later listings skipped while full
rules.costs: 5 bps taker per side + 30 bps slippage per side (stress), actual settled funding

data: Binance public REST daily klines and funding history, recomputed statelessly every day

review.first_look: after 30 closed trades (status only, no rule changes)
review.gate: after >= 50 closed trades: mean net return > 0 with month-block bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0 and BTC-hedged mean > 0
review.kill: stop the forward early if 20 consecutive closed trades have mean net < -5%

live_trading: never enabled by this protocol; a pass only authorizes a separate small-capital proposal
